title: Inference on Direct-Effect Sets across Compatible Completions of Difference DAGs
banked_reason: Substrate unbuildable: field-tier mathematics passed discovery, but faithful axiom-free Lean formalization requires missing real-semialgebraic foundations and a local LDiffPC soundness development.
gap_reasons: The requested axiom-free API depends on foundational real algebraic geometry absent from both Mathlib and Causalean: real-closed-field quantifier elimination, semialgebraic cell decomposition and dimension theory, finite Whitney/Nash stratification, and semialgebraic Sard.

The paper-specific residual is the complete LDiffPC algorithm plus its Definition 2–4 diff-separation semantics and Theorem 1 skeleton/orientation proof. Further work is therefore an implementation of the cited 2026 paper, not a small bridge.
Closing only downstream consequences cannot remove their foundational dependency.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery completed and passed at field tier with the paired-Wishart covariance-fiber coverage theorem, boundary random-set law, bounded constant-factor minimax bracket, and global converse. Formalization planning then showed that the headline theorem depends on both a complete local formalization of LDiffPC and foundational real-semialgebraic projection, dimension, Whitney/Nash, and Sard infrastructure; the side study produced only sorry-bearing scaffolds and correctly escalated as unbuildable. Retry after those foundations exist axiom-free, or after a reviewed specialization removes them without weakening the stated theorem.
tldr: This SCM partial-identification paper takes the compatible-completion direct-effect fiber \(\Psi(s)\), rather than a selected LDiffPC graph or point-identified coefficient, as its primary causal target. It proves a finite semialgebraic branch representation and projects an exact paired Wishart covariance region through every compatible diff-faithful completion, covering the fixed true direct-effect triple without equality, conditional-independence, beta-min, or completion-separation margins. Rational predecessor regressions imply branch smoothness on the positive-definite covariance domain, and tangent-cone regularity then yields zeroth- and first-order Fell random-set limits at simultaneous ledger boundaries. Same-law chain--fork witnesses prove every-dimension noncontraction and unrestricted infinite worst-case expected diameter, while an exact three-variable collider audit shows that unresolved structure can nevertheless yield a singleton fiber. On the separately declared coefficient/covariance-bounded Gaussian subclass, the same projection has exact finite-sample coverage and expected diameter within factor \(2\sqrt3/(1-2\gamma)\) of minimax. A compact-hyperspace kernel argument also attains each bounded Gaussian tangent decision problem as an exact semi-infinite variational benchmark, without producing an explicit optimizer or finite-sample dominance claim.
gap: BystrovaDevijver2026LDiffPC supplies population discovery of a typed difference DAG from cross-environment regression equalities but no effect inference. StriederDrton2024DualLikelihood Theorem 2 establishes asymptotic test inversion, structure unioning, and an explicit confidence construction for one scalar total effect under unknown single-environment equal-error-variance Gaussian DAG structure; StriederDrton2023Confidence treats the same single-environment total-effect setting; WangKolarDrton2023ConfidenceSets uses residual-bootstrap goodness-of-fit tests in identifiable additive-error structural equation models to obtain asymptotic causal-order confidence sets and post-processed model-uncertainty effect intervals; ChangGuoMalinsky2026PostSelection gives asymptotic screening-union coverage after ordinary conditional-independence discovery; GraduZrnicWangJordan2025ValidInference targets an effect indexed by a randomized selected graph; and GuoWuYiu2026Price gives exact selective coverage for a selected adjustment functional after Gaussian FCI with known variance. None supplies the exact paired unrestricted-covariance Wishart pivot, the two-environment LDiffPC equality/sepset direct-effect fiber, exact unconditional coverage for a fixed direct-effect triple, the jointly local branch-cone boundary random-set law, or a same-law width lower bound for that fiber.
fill: The project proves exact uniform coverage, derives the zeroth- and first-order boundary random-set limits, gives the exact cone-aware score-image reduction on a regular singleton branch and its product-score form at ambient-interior points, and certifies an exact observational-equivalence lower bound. It leaves the genuinely nonroutine optimal-width acceptance-region problem explicit.
